==Notes==
*Upon using an offensive magic spell, there is a chance that the element of one magic [[Voidwatch Weaknesses|vulnerability]] will be revealed.
** If in possession of the [[periapt of clarity]], the type of spell (white magic, black magic, bard song, ninjutsu, or blue magic) will be revealed in addition to the element.
